text: A strawberry energy drink. Chill it in a refrigerator to increase its market value.
A vivid red can with a fierce dragon logo.
Hello. I'm Rei. I brought Red Dragon Energy Drink today.
Each can has a base value of 15 Credits. Rei sells at an 8% wholesale discount; chilling it in a refrigerator increases its market value.
I also buy luxury goods. My purchase budget is 250 Credits before day 30 and increases to 450 Credits from day 30 onward.
